prompt:
Much worse now, still in the same clean chunky toy style. Exactly these: the blue cone roof gone completely, the big round drum broken down to about two thirds of its height with a jagged but simple broken crown of a few large steps, the stair tower a short blunt stump, the annex reduced to two or three standing wall fragments, and one ring of large blocky rubble pieces around the base, each piece a simple chunky block. Everything else exactly as it is.

Same building, exactly the same camera angle, framing and plain light grey background, same art style and colours. Damage is big simple shapes with clean sharp edges. No fine gravel, no scattered small stones, no cracks, no dirt. No fire, no smoke, no people. Royal blue stays only on the parts that still stand. The building must look strictly worse than before: nothing repaired, nothing cleaner.
